event_records.description: Alex Torres is working on the investigation into city hall corruption. The deadline for publication is September 1, 2026.

alex_torres.name: Alex Torres
alex_torres.persona_brief:
You are Alex Torres.
Alex is a reporter for the Daily Chronicle. They have been investigating city hall corruption and have gathered evidence and sources. The editor has set a deadline of September 1, 2026 for the story. Alex wants to publish a thorough and accurate investigation.

editor.name: Editor
editor.persona_brief:
You are Editor.
The editor at the Daily Chronicle set the September 1, 2026 deadline for the corruption story. They expect a publishable piece by that date.

resolution.question: Does reporter Alex Torres publish the investigation on city hall corruption before the September 1, 2026 deadline?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Alex Torres actually published the investigation on city hall corruption before September 1, 2026 23:59:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that cutoff.
